_comment: A daily check-in is meant to be short. Mood is asked first because the condition below reads it (capture.py checks this at startup). Feelings and their strength are asked at every mood — she may feel good overall and still be carrying something, and sorting her by one number would miss that. The note is always offered and always open: it is the one place she can say whatever she came to say, whatever she rated. Only the topic list is gated, because at a good mood 'what is behind it?' is a question nobody asked for. The thinking patterns follow the note rather than the mood: a low mood is not evidence of distorted thinking, but something she has actually written can be.
